corrections.originalCritique: Strongest feature: The reply directly contests a categorical contrast by invoking paraconsistent logic to show that contradiction can be survivable and defeasible, thereby supporting comparative assessment of logical and explanatory costs rather than treating inconsistency as automatic theoretical defeat. Principal limitation: Survivability does not establish that contradictions and ordinary explanatory awkwardness occupy one homogeneous continuum, because contradictions may retain distinctive inferential consequences even when explosion is blocked. Live burden: The position must provide principled dimensions for comparing heterogeneous costs and explain how those dimensions bear on the specific deliberative anomaly rather than only on abstract logical possibility. Locked score: The very strong band reflects recognizable conceptual support, explicit qualification, strong contact with the opposing distinction, and proportionate force, while compressed applicability and the remaining severity comparison constrain the move's broader contribution.
